elements.label: Figure A9
elements.title: Excel graphing menu options
elements.details: Screenshot of Excel's graphing menu showing various chart types including Column, Line, Pie, Bar, Area, Scatter, and others. The menu is a dropdown from the Insert tab with icons and labels for each chart type.
elements.summary: This screenshot shows the menu in Excel where users can select different types of graphs and visualizations to create, illustrating the variety of options available for data visualization in Excel.
